dataset.selection: First 20 repository symbols plus 20 evenly spaced universe members; selected without future returns

assumptions.detection: Visible candidate category or BUY action, valid data and non-HIGH risk, strictly before day-high bar
limitations: No historical broker flow or corporate-action calendar
